title: DesktopStateSchema
description: Google Antigravity Desktop application state and migration tracking schema (~/.gemini/antigravity/antigravity_state.pbtxt / state).

installation_uuid.description: Unique installation UUID for the desktop application.

post_onboarding.description: Whether the primary onboarding sequence has been completed.

seen_nuxs.description: List of new-user experience (NUX) dialog IDs acknowledged by the user.

agent_onboarding_completed.description: Whether agent persona onboarding walkthrough has finished.

last_selected_agent_model.description: Most recently chosen model identifier in the UI.

migrate_convos_into_projects.description: Flag indicating legacy conversation migration status.

migrate_retroactive_projects.description: Flag indicating project retroactive auto-discovery migration status.

migrations.description: List of applied database/state migration identifiers.
